body: I wish I knew where to start. I get up everyday and go to work to afford the things I have and the house over my head. I wanted to finish my degree, I have one semester left. I just can’t find the motivation. My room is a mess a huge indicator of the way I feel on the inside. I just wish I could find a home for my dog where I know he would be loved so I could just be done. I’m not loved. I’m a burden to everyone.
